Patients with static deficits only who do not have a neurodegenerative syndrome.

inclusion: Have capacity to consent at the beginning of their involvement

Have a diagnosis of a neurodegenerative disease which includes progressive supranuclear palsy, corticobasal syndrome and multiple system atrophy but may include other closely related diseases where the presentation is similar, such as Alzheimer's disease where they present with a corticobasal syndrome

official_title: Utilisation of Health Services and Quality of Life in Patients With Atypical Parkinsonian Syndromes
sponsor: University Hospital Southampton NHS Foundation Trust
summary: The study will compare health care utilisation and quality of life for patients with progressive supranuclear palsy, corticobasal syndrome and multiple system atrophy in different parts of the region that our specialist clinic operates in with different services as well as in other regions with no specialist clinics. This study aims to investigate which aspects of the service are most beneficial for the patients and to determine the influence of support services and specialty clinics on patients and their carers.
title: Utilisation of Health Services and Quality of Life in Patients With Atypical Parkinsonian Syndromes
